name: ROCKWOOL
verdict: Danish stone-wool maker listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen; largest shareholder is the family-founded ROCKWOOL Foundation (23% of shares, 28% of votes). Nothing found.
note: ROCKWOOL brand of ROCKWOOL A/S (Hedehusene, Denmark); Title Partner of the Denmark SailGP team (ROCKWOOL Racing SailGP Team) since 2019, renewed November 2025 through the end of 2032 (PR Newswire/SailGP release, checked 2026-10-03). Since February 2026 the team itself is owned and operated by American Magic (Doug DeVos). Ownership chain tops out at ROCKWOOL A/S; its largest single shareholder is the non-commercial ROCKWOOL Foundation, with no state or state fund anywhere in the chain.
